visible_text: 让上下文持续产生价值
prompt:
Use case: productivity-visual
Asset type: complete rasterized presentation slide, not a background asset and not a collage.
Primary request: create one polished 16:9 presentation slide for the cover page.
Communication purpose: 建立主题与核心判断
Single claim: AI 原生知识工作流
Audience: 产品团队、知识工作者与组织管理者
Art direction: premium independent magazine spread with a strong point of view
Composition/framing: asymmetric page rhythm, serif-led headline, cropped documentary image, intentional tension. one editorial headline block with no more than two short supporting lines; keep the opposite half visually quiet.
Frozen layout plan: text safe zone = left-bottom; visual zone = right or center-right; hierarchy = headline > supporting copy > visual anchor; density = low; one dominant visual anchor.
Scene and visual brief: A calm visual metaphor for scattered notes becoming one connected, reusable knowledge flow; one dominant anchor and generous negative space
Imagery: documentary editorial photography with visible texture and honest light
Color palette: paper ivory, carbon black, oxide red, muted marine blue
Materials/textures: uncoated paper grain, hairline rules, print-like image treatment
Theme anchors: oxide-red editorial marker; off-center image crop; issue-like micro label
Text (verbatim; render every line exactly once, with correct Chinese characters and punctuation):
1. "AI 原生知识工作流"
2. "让上下文持续产生价值"
Typography: make the headline large enough for a projector; use a coherent Chinese font pairing; keep line breaks intentional and do not shrink text to fit.
Text safety: paper or deep-charcoal text field must remain readable; never place text over a busy face or high-frequency texture; no face, object, highlight, grid, or light path may pass behind the letters.
Information boundary: use only the supplied visible text; do not invent metrics, labels, citations, UI, logos, product screens, names, dates, or claims.
Constraints: render the complete slide as one finished image; preserve a clear visual hierarchy; keep generous margins; use one dominant visual anchor; no editable UI; no watermark; no logo.
Avoid: website cards; tech neon; perfect symmetry; generic luxury gold; extra words; misspelled Chinese; gibberish; tiny labels; dense card grids; busy detail behind text; decorative pseudo-data.
Continuity anchor: theme-showcase-anchor; continuity group: theme-showcase.
